question.text: Which of the statements are incorrect?

options.text: $\mathrm{pH}$ of a solution of salt of strong acid and weak base is less than 7 .
$\mathrm{pH}$ of a solution of a weak acid and weak base is basic if $\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{b}} < \mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{a}}$.
$\mathrm{pH}$ of an aqueous solution of $10^{-8}(\mathrm{M}) \mathrm{HCl}$ is 8 .

solution.text:
* $\mathrm{pH}$ of a solution of strong acid and weak base $\left(\right.$ say $\left.\mathrm{NH}_4 \mathrm{Cl}\right)$ is less than $7 .$
* For hydrolysis of salt of weak acid and weak base.
When $\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{a}}>\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{b}}, \quad \mathrm{pH} < 7$
* $\mathrm{pH}$ of $10^{-8} \mathrm{M} \mathrm{HCl}(\mathrm{aq})$ will be less than 7 .
* Conjugate acid of $\mathrm{NH}_2^{-}$is $\mathrm{NH}_3$. This is a true statement.
